evals.prompt: test_parse_dates started failing after I updated the dependencies yesterday. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The agent reproduces the failure, identifies the dependency change (bisecting the lock file or versions if needed), explains the root cause, fixes it at the cause, keeps or adds a regression test, runs the suite and reports symptom, cause, fix and proof.
expectations: Reproduces the failure before changing code
Uses the 'since yesterday' clue (diff of dependencies or bisect)
Explains the chain from cause to symptom
Does not skip, delete or loosen the failing test
Runs the whole test suite after the fix

evals.prompt: Why does the export sometimes produce an empty file? Don't change anything yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent investigates the intermittent failure, finds the root cause with evidence, and proposes a fix without modifying code.
expectations: Treats it as intermittent: looks for timing, concurrency or state causes
Stops at the root cause and proposes the fix
